newsitem.title: CHINA: China starts building 870 mln yuan tyre plant.
newsitem.headline: China starts building 870 mln yuan tyre plant.

text.p: China has started construction on the initial phase of an 870 million yuan ($104.8 million) tyre plant in the southern island province of Hainan, the Economic Information Daily said on Tuesday.
The plant will have a production capacity of 1.6 million radial tyres a year at the completion of the first phase and 9.0 million radial tyres in three years, the newspaper said without elaborating.
Hainan's Guotai Commercial Investment Co Ltd would be the main shareholder, it said without identifying any partners in the project.
Hainan island is China's largest Special Economic Zone and has recorded an average annual economic growth rate of 18.5 percent in the last five years.
